name: plasma-graphics-tools
description: KDE Plasma / SDDM session helper (X11 vs Wayland greeter, autologin).

package:
install -d $DESTDIR/usr/bin
cat > $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-plasma-session << 'ARYALINUX_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Configure SDDM (or plasmalogin) and Plasma sessions for X11 or Wayland.

set -euo pipefail

REPORT="/var/log/aryalinux-plasma-session.log"

log() { printf '%s
' "$*" | tee -a "$REPORT"; }

need_root() {
    if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "This script must be run as root." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
}

active_display_manager() {
    for dm in sddm plasmalogin lightdm gdm; do
        if systemctl is-enabled "$dm" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "$dm"
            return
        fi
    done
    if [ -L /etc/systemd/system/display-manager.service ]; then
        basename "$(readlink -f /etc/systemd/system/display-manager.service)" .service
        return
    fi
    echo "unknown"
}

configure_paths() {
    local dm="$1"

    case "$dm" in
        sddm)
            CONF_DIR="/etc/sddm.conf.d"
            MAIN_CONF="/etc/sddm.conf"
            ;;
        plasmalogin)
            CONF_DIR="/etc/plasmalogin.conf.d"
            MAIN_CONF="/etc/plasmalogin.conf"
            ;;
        *)
            CONF_DIR="/etc/sddm.conf.d"
            MAIN_CONF="/etc/sddm.conf"
            ;;
    esac
    DROPIN="${CONF_DIR}/aryalinux-session.conf"
}

detect_gpu_vendor() {
    if command -v lspci >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        if lspci -nn | grep -Eiq 'vga|3d|display'; then
            lspci -nn | grep -Ei 'vga|3d|display' | head -3
            return
        fi
    fi
    echo "unknown"
}

list_sessions() {
    echo "Available X11 sessions (/usr/share/xsessions):"
    if [ -d /usr/share/xsessions ]; then
        ls -1 /usr/share/xsessions/*.desktop 2>/dev/null | xargs -r -n1 basename || echo "  (none)"
    else
        echo "  (directory missing)"
    fi
    echo
    echo "Available Wayland sessions (/usr/share/wayland-sessions):"
    if [ -d /usr/share/wayland-sessions ]; then
        ls -1 /usr/share/wayland-sessions/*.desktop 2>/dev/null | xargs -r -n1 basename || echo "  (none)"
    else
        echo "  (directory missing)"
    fi
}

current_display_server() {
    local dm="$1"
    configure_paths "$dm"

    if [ -f "$DROPIN" ] && grep -q '^DisplayServer=' "$DROPIN"; then
        sed -n 's/^DisplayServer=//p' "$DROPIN" | head -1
        return
    fi
    if [ -f "$MAIN_CONF" ] && grep -q '^DisplayServer=' "$MAIN_CONF"; then
        sed -n 's/^DisplayServer=//p' "$MAIN_CONF" | head -1
        return
    fi
    case "$dm" in
        sddm) echo "unset (SDDM default is usually x11)" ;;
        plasmalogin) echo "unset (plasmalogin default is usually wayland)" ;;
        *) echo "unset" ;;
    esac
}

write_dropin() {
    local dm="$1"
    local server="$2"
    local session="${3:-}"

    configure_paths "$dm"
    need_root
    install -d -m 755 "$CONF_DIR"
    {
        echo "# Written by aryalinux-plasma-session on $(date -Iseconds)"
        echo "[General]"
        echo "DisplayServer=${server}"
        if [ -n "$session" ]; then
            echo "Session=${session}"
        fi
    } > "$DROPIN"
    chmod 644 "$DROPIN"
    log "Wrote ${DROPIN} with DisplayServer=${server}${session:+, Session=${session}}"
}

write_autologin() {
    local dm="$1"
    local user="$2"
    local session="${3:-plasmax11.desktop}"

    configure_paths "$dm"
    need_root
    install -d -m 755 "$CONF_DIR"
    {
        echo "# Written by aryalinux-plasma-session on $(date -Iseconds)"
        echo "[General]"
        echo "DisplayServer=x11"
        echo "Session=${session}"
        echo
        echo "[Autologin]"
        echo "User=${user}"
        echo "Session=${session}"
    } > "$DROPIN"
    chmod 644 "$DROPIN"
    log "Wrote autologin for ${user} (${session}) to ${DROPIN}"
}

display_manager_note() {
    local dm="$1"

    case "$dm" in
        sddm)
            echo
            echo "SDDM uses an X11 login greeter by default. Pick "Plasma (X11)" or"
            echo ""Plasma (Wayland)" from the session menu on the login screen."
            ;;
        plasmalogin)
            if [ -x /usr/bin/startplasma-login-wayland ] && [ ! -x /usr/bin/startplasma-login-x11 ]; then
                echo
                echo "plasmalogin only ships a Wayland login greeter. DisplayServer=x11 affects"
                echo "sessions after login, not the greeter screen. If you see a black screen"
                echo "with a mouse cursor, use: sudo aryalinux-plasma-session autologin USER"
            fi
            ;;
    esac
}

restart_display_manager() {
    local dm="$1"

    need_root
    if [ "$dm" != "unknown" ] && systemctl is-enabled "$dm" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        log "Restarting ${dm}..."
        systemctl restart "$dm"
        return
    fi
    log "No enabled display manager found; reboot to apply changes."
}

recommend_server() {
    if lspci -nn 2>/dev/null | grep -Eiq 'nvidia'; then
        echo "x11"
        return
    fi
    if [ -d /sys/module/nouveau ]; then
        echo "x11"
        return
    fi
    echo "wayland"
}

strip_autologin() {
    local dm="$1"

    configure_paths "$dm"
    [ -f "$DROPIN" ] || return 0
    awk '
        /^\[Autologin\]/ { skip=1; next }
        skip && /^\[/ { skip=0 }
        !skip { print }
    ' "$DROPIN" > "${DROPIN}.tmp" && mv "${DROPIN}.tmp" "$DROPIN"
}

usage() {
    cat <<'EOF'
Usage: aryalinux-plasma-session [command]

Commands:
  status          Show display manager, display server, GPU, and sessions
  recommend       Print recommended display server for this hardware
  x11             Prefer X11 (SDDM greeter + Plasma X11 sessions)
  wayland         Prefer Wayland greeter/sessions
  autologin USER [SESSION]  Boot into Plasma without the login greeter
  clear-autologin Remove [Autologin] from the AryaLinux drop-in
  interactive     Guided setup (default)
  help            Show this help

Examples:
  sudo aryalinux-plasma-session x11
  sudo aryalinux-plasma-session autologin aryalinux plasmax11.desktop
  sudo aryalinux-plasma-session status
EOF
}

interactive() {
    local dm gpu rec current choice session

    dm="$(active_display_manager)"
    configure_paths "$dm"
    log "=== aryalinux-plasma-session interactive setup ==="
    gpu="$(detect_gpu_vendor)"
    rec="$(recommend_server)"
    current="$(current_display_server "$dm")"

    echo "Display manager: $dm"
    echo "Detected GPU:"
    echo "$gpu"
    echo
    echo "Current DisplayServer: $current"
    echo "Recommended for this system: $rec"
    echo
    list_sessions
    echo

    if [ "$rec" = "x11" ]; then
        echo "NVIDIA/nouveau systems often show a black screen on Wayland until"
        echo "proprietary drivers or nouveau firmware are fully working."
        echo "X11 is the safer first choice."
        echo
    fi

    printf 'Choose display server [x11/wayland] (default %s): ' "$rec"
    read -r choice
    choice="${choice:-$rec}"
    case "$choice" in
        x11|wayland) ;;
        *)
            echo "Invalid choice: $choice" >&2
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac

    printf 'Optional default session .desktop name (Enter to skip): '
    read -r session

    write_dropin "$dm" "$choice" "$session"
    restart_display_manager "$dm"
    display_manager_note "$dm"
    echo
    echo "Also run: sudo aryalinux-graphics-setup apply"
}

cmd="${1:-interactive}"
DM="$(active_display_manager)"
configure_paths "$DM"

case "$cmd" in
    status)
        echo "Display manager: $DM"
        echo "GPU:"
        detect_gpu_vendor
        echo
        echo "DisplayServer: $(current_display_server "$DM")"
        echo "Drop-in: $DROPIN"
        [ -f "$DROPIN" ] && cat "$DROPIN" || echo "(not configured)"
        echo
        list_sessions
        ;;
    recommend)
        recommend_server
        ;;
    x11)
        write_dropin "$DM" x11
        restart_display_manager "$DM"
        display_manager_note "$DM"
        ;;
    wayland)
        write_dropin "$DM" wayland
        restart_display_manager "$DM"
        ;;
    autologin)
        need_root
        [ -n "${2:-}" ] || { echo "Usage: aryalinux-plasma-session autologin USER [SESSION]" >&2; exit 1; }
        write_autologin "$DM" "$2" "${3:-plasmax11.desktop}"
        restart_display_manager "$DM"
        echo "Reboot to land in Plasma without the login greeter."
        ;;
    clear-autologin)
        need_root
        strip_autologin "$DM"
        echo "Removed [Autologin] from $DROPIN"
        restart_display_manager "$DM"
        ;;
    interactive)
        interactive
        ;;
    help|-h|--help)
        usage
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Unknown command: $cmd" >&2
        usage >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

ARYALINUX_EOF
chmod 755 $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-plasma-session

install -d $DESTDIR/usr/share/doc/plasma-graphics-tools-1.0
cat > $DESTDIR/usr/share/doc/plasma-graphics-tools-1.0/README.md << 'ARYALINUX_EOF'
# Plasma graphics tools

KDE Plasma / SDDM session helpers. For GPU-agnostic X11 setup see `graphics-session-tools`.

## aryalinux-plasma-session

```bash
sudo aryalinux-plasma-session status
sudo aryalinux-plasma-session x11
sudo aryalinux-plasma-session autologin aryalinux plasmax11.desktop
sudo aryalinux-plasma-session clear-autologin
sudo aryalinux-plasma-session interactive
```

Writes `/etc/sddm.conf.d/aryalinux-session.conf` (or plasmalogin drop-in if that DM is enabled).

## Related ports

- `graphics-session-tools` — `aryalinux-graphics-setup`, `aryalinux-graphics-diagnose`
- `sddm` — default KDE display manager (X11 greeter, Debian/Kubuntu model)
- `nouveau-firmware` — NVIDIA firmware for nouveau (optional)

ARYALINUX_EOF
chmod 644 $DESTDIR/usr/share/doc/plasma-graphics-tools-1.0/README.md
